appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled '0-19 years vs 20-39 years'.
The x-axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 2012 to 2020.
The y-axis on the left is labeled '0-19 years'.
The y-axis on the right is labeled '20-39 years'.
The blue line with solid circles represents the 0-19 years cohort population.
The red line with square markers represents the 20-39 years cohort population.
The blue line starts at a higher value in 2012 and declines until around 2015, then rises again.
The red line starts at a lower value in 2012 and rises steadily until 2020.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the public demographic planning dashboard, compare the 2012 population for 0-19 years and 20-39 years, then open the age-cohort planning follow-up record for the cohort with the larger 2012 population.
The comparison scope is the 2012 population for the 0-19 years cohort and the 20-39 years cohort.
The rules are to use the public demographic planning dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2012 age-cohort population is larger.
